messages:
Maria (Support): heads up — we got two incoming asks that look like the same feature from different customers: ACME corp ticket #8421 and BetaHealth ticket #8590. both request tenant-level routing for dedicated instances.
Alex (PM): copying in product ops. Are these strictly duplicates or variations? any differing acceptance criteria?
Maria (Support): quick scan — ACME wants regional affinity + SLA isolation, BetaHealth just calls it 'dedicated routing' (likely SLA too). so overlap is high. i put both into the intake queue and added `needs_spec` tag.
Devon (Product Ops): thanks. let's consolidate into a single canonical request so we don't fragment priority. propose: mark ACME #8421 as canonical (more detail), merge BetaHealth into it, and set label `customer_ask/duplicate` on #8590.
Sam (Eng): okay from eng side as long as we get minimal acceptance criteria: 1) route by tenant id -> region preference 2) fallback policy 3) perf SLO (p95 < 200ms for control plane). do we know expected qps?
Maria (Support): ACME quoted ~120 req/s, BetaHealth ~30 req/s in peak. both want soft rollout in Q3.
Alex (PM): good data. priority check: this maps to the "Dedicated routing" initiative (infra roadmap). impact = high for enterprise sales. recommend priority = P1 for backlog grooming. Devon, can you schedule a triage sweep?
Devon (Product Ops): scheduling a triage sweep for tomorrow 10am PT. agenda: confirm canonical ticket, capture ACs, map to initiative, ask legal about SLA language. i'll create a grooming card and assign owners.
triage-bot: Automated: Created grooming card https://redwood.internal/groom/PR-551 and linked tickets #8421, #8590.
Sam (Eng): for the job ticket please include: expected throughput, sample traffic shape, any existing routing policy, and whether this must work on Private deployments. otherwise we have to scope per-deployment fold.
Alex (PM): note — sales flagged this as a close-won blocker for ACME. we should notify account team with an ETA after grooming.
Maria (Support): drafting response to both customers now: "Thanks — we've consolidated your requests and will proceed under ticket #8421. we'll follow up after our triage call tomorrow with owners and tentative ETA." would like :thumbsup: before send.
Devon (Product Ops): +1. also propose the following labels on the canonical ticket: `initiative/dedicated-routing`, `impact/enterprise`, `priority/p1`, `blocked-by/legal-sla` (if legal needs review).
Sam (Eng): add `needs_perf_eval` too.
Alex (PM): agreed. action items: Devon — run triage + update PR-551; Sam — draft rough spec stub (include perf ACs) by EOD Friday; Maria — send consolidation reply to customers now; I'll update roadmap lane and notify sales.
Maria (Support): sending message to customers now. cc @account-team.
triage-bot: Update: PR-551 scheduled 2025-08-13T17:00:00Z. Participants invited: Alex (PM), Devon (Product Ops), Sam (Eng), Maria (Support).
Alex (PM): thanks team. we'll use the grooming to decide if this is scope for Dedicated-only or needs Hosted parity. keep thread updated with any changes.
Maria (Support): ping if you want me to pull anything from the tickets before the meeting.
Sam (Eng): i'll sketch a minimal implementation plan after the spec stub.
Devon (Product Ops): noted. closing loop here — will post post-groom notes + assigned owners in this thread after the meeting.
